targets.authors: Liu, D., Jiang, K., Shalley, C. E., Keem, S., & Zhou, J.
targets.title: Motivational mechanisms of employee creativity: A meta-analytic examination and theoretical extension of the creativity literature.
targets.evidence_quote: H* (SCORE focal test): Intrinsic motivation is positively associated with creativity. Hypothesis 1 from Liu et al.: Hypothesis 1. Controlling for creative self-efficacy and prosocial motivation, intrinsic motivation makes a unique contribution to creativity.
targets.outcome_quote: Model 1a and Model 1b in Table 3 both support the claim. The intrinsic motivation term from Model 1 serves as evidence for SCORE.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The report explicitly supports the focal claim in both models.

reasoning: Identity verified from the report heading, authors and original citation; short complete SCORE report with tables and citation.
